model: The emitted 2 bytes are a deterministic function of (caller disclosure, relationship, record state, evidence). byte0 = (disclosure<<6)|(state<<4)|reason ; byte1 = (retry<<6)|(detail_source<<4)|detail_code. HARD RULE: any caller that is not a proven peer WITH a prior relationship/binding receives 0x0000 — silence — never a state/reason nibble. Honest status is relationship-scoped, not merely auth-scoped, so a trusted peer cannot become an enumeration oracle for a peer it never had a binding with. RELATIONSHIP (normative, see SPEC.md v10): relationship=true means a prior bilateral binding the far side can verify — an active session, a local mux-lane registration, a prior AINS/JIS binding, bilateral consent, or an existing tombstone-relation. ALIVE-ACK: 0x4000 is OPTIONAL — only a response to an explicit status query/diagnostic on the trusted path; the data plane stays silent on success (no news is good news), only absence/failure is fed back.
